results.title: Think Twice
results.overview: Mike just wrapped a late-night shoot when four masked men jump him in the parking lot, pistol-whip him and drive off with his whole camera package. He wants his gun. Jada wants the one thing they left behind: a chapstick that fell out of a robber's pocket. Magic is high tonight, and four robbers are about to find out why you think twice before you mess with the wrong ones.

results.title: Project SLC
results.overview: During a fated Halloween night, Documentary Filmmaker Dillonius Bus follows Bardonial on his quest to Project SLC. After ripping to many cigs and commiting DIVOLJA, Bardonial finds himself in a cuckery contest against the Antagonist Gus. In this personal account of the rise and fall of a friendship between two brothers.

results.title: Last Stream
results.overview: Desperate for views, a fading streamer stages a fake haunting connected to an unsolved case. The stream spirals into a real-time nightmare watched by tens of thousands and someone in the chat seems to know exactly how the night will end.

results.title: What Lurks
results.overview: On Halloween night, a man sets out on a solitary walk through the streets of Dublin. Unbeknownst to him, his friends are trailing close behind in the shadows, determined to uncover the mystery of where he goes when he thinks no one is watching.

results.title: The Fragrance Of Return
results.overview: Fennel is an herb, vegetable, and medicine with a pungent aroma that divides people—some adore it, others despise it. Rarely eaten in Taiwan, it remains a fading memory in the food culture of the Dapu Hakka in Dongshi–Shigang. Shuling returns home to grow and promote fennel, hoping to revive its taste, though many challenges await her...

results.title: Happy to Help
results.overview: Facing the pressure of failing relationships and deadlines closing in, one aimless man turns to artificial intelligence for companionship and productivity; however, he doesn't realize that giving in to the machine will completely strip him of his humanity.

results.title: Big Tree Guardian
results.overview: Ten years ago, Dr. Hsu discovered a Taiwan cypress bound by steel cables in the mountains, sparking a long rescue journey. The "Tree Seekers" team traveled across Taiwan, developing tree-climbing and cable-removal skills to free giant "cable trees." They rescued Song Yun-Yun, Iron Man, Kingma, and Fat Tiger. Returning to the original tree after a decade, they removed its restraints and named it "Sun Wukong." This film follows a decade-long journey of rescue, memory, and forest connection.
